newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Wednesday, but buying interest waned in the second session, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,400 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at five rupiah above and below the range. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,231 rupiah at a tender in Medan.

"The increases in Malaysia in late trading caused some sellers to close early in the hope they will be able to raise prices tomorrow," one trader said. "But Malaysian prices began declining towards the end of the session."

Traders said sentiment in the early session was boosted by the overnight gains in Chicago soyoil futures and news that Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking 10,000 tonnes of May delivery palm oil for May delivery Malaysia or Indonesia.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Inora will leave for Pasir Gudang, Malaysia, on Thursday with 15,000 tonnes of crude palm oil. The KM Permaisuri will leave on Thursday for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta with 2,200 tonnes of palm olein.
